_comment: Lockfile for the CDN assets used by v2/spikes/g3-render/index.html (no build step). Exact versions, URLs and SRI hashes (sha384 of the bytes served on resolved_on). Change this file, the <script>/<link> tags in index.html, and docs/experiments/g3-rendering.md together.

maplibre-gl.why_not_latest: Latest on resolved_on was 6.16.0, but MapLibre GL JS 6.0.0 switched to an ESM-only distribution (dist/maplibre-gl.mjs + dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs); the UMD bundle maplibre-gl.js is no longer published, so cdnjs 6.x carries only the CSS. 5.24.0 is the newest release with a classic <script> bundle. See CHANGELOG 6.0.0: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

d3-array.why: Runtime dependency of the d3-contour UMD build (it reads d3-array from the global `d3`); must load before d3-contour. cdnjs only had 3.2.4, so both d3 packages come from jsdelivr.

d3-contour.why: Not on cdnjs (404), so pinned from jsdelivr.

basemap.usage_policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ (dev/low volume only; swap for a commercial or self-hosted tile source before any public release)
